full_track.tags: K-Pop Power Ballad. Distorted electric guitar power chords and a driving rock drum kit with heavy compression. A high-register male tenor vocal performs with emotional intensity and vibrato. Synthesizer pads provide harmonic density in the background. The bass guitar follows the kick drum pattern with a thick, overdriven tone. Tempo is 145 BPM in the key of E Major. The arrangement features a sudden dynamic shift from a dense rock chorus to a more rhythmic, synth-driven verse with syncopated bass lines.
